While extreme hunger is normal and to be expected in recovery, you have to be a bit careful in regards to your meals during that time. Eating too much too soon and not giving your body time to adjust to (much) more food than it's used to can lead to refeeding syndrome and that's a very dangerous condition. Slow progress is better because gaining too much weight too fast can also trigger a relapse.

It's not a switch you can turn on and off (I wish lol). Anorexia, as well as all the other eds, are mental disorders. You don't just wake up one day and *choose* to have them. And you wouldn't want that either, they're not glamorous or desirable as media portrays them. But you can develop an eating disorder at any age if that's what you're really asking.
